SHAPES, PATTERNS & SORTING WORKSHEETS

Shapes, Patterns & Sorting worksheets — free printables for age 4.

Shape matching, patterns, sorting and symmetry — the printable twins of the Shape Adventures games. Every sheet twins with a real game in Shapes, Patterns & Sorting (Class 25) — download the PDF, print from the page, or play online.

Build a Shape Spaceship Age 4Class 25Shapes A rocket with four shape-shaped holes: match the pieces, color the parts, and the spaceship is ready to fly. View Worksheet → Silly Monster Factory Age 4Class 25Shapes A friendly monster with empty spots for eyes, horns, arms and feet — design him on paper with shapes. View Worksheet → Hot Air Balloon Patterns Age 4Class 25Shapes AB and AAB patterns to finish with a pencil: say the pattern out loud, then draw what lands next. View Worksheet → Candy Shape Shop Age 4Class 25Shapes Sort the shop’s candy by shape: circle candies here, square candies there — with scissors practice built in. View Worksheet → Rainbow Window Puzzle Age 4Class 25Shapes The rainbow windows lost their glass: match each shape to its dashed outline and the light comes back. View Worksheet → Animal Shape Houses Age 4Class 25Shapes Six animal friends, six shape houses: draw the line from each animal to the house that fits. View Worksheet → Submarine Window Rescue Age 4Class 25Shapes The submarine’s windows popped out! Match the portholes and bring the crew safely home. View Worksheet → Turtle Shell Mosaic Age 4Class 25Shapes The turtle’s shell lost its tiles: match the mosaic pieces and finish the pattern work. View Worksheet → Fruit Market Sorting Age 4Class 25Shapes Two market crates, one sorting rule: apples to the red crate, frogs to the green — cut, sort, glue. View Worksheet → Wizard’s Magic Patterns Age 4Class 25Shapes The wizard’s spell needs three patterns finished: AB, AAB and the tricky ABC. View Worksheet → Peacock Feather Symmetry Age 4Class 25Shapes The peacock’s left feathers are missing: finish the mirror picture so both sides match. View Worksheet → Shape Ferris Wheel Age 4Class 25Shapes The ferris wheel cabins are empty: match each shape cabin to its outline and the ride can open. View Worksheet → Dragon Scale Puzzle Age 4Class 25Shapes The baby dragon lost some scales: match each scale shape to the space on its back. View Worksheet → Penguin Dress-Up Patterns Age 4Class 25Shapes Color patterns to finish: hats and scarves in AB and AAB rows — what color lands next? View Worksheet → Shape Clock Tower Age 4Class 25Shapes The clock tower’s gears are mixed up: match the shape gears to their outlines and the clock ticks again. View Worksheet → Enchanted Mushroom Garden Age 4Class 25Shapes Patterns grow in the mushroom garden: finish the AB, AAB and ABC rows to wake the garden up. View Worksheet → Cookie Cutter Bakery Age 4Class 25Shapes The bakery needs shape cookies: match each cutter to its cookie outline before the oven rings.
